new_implications: For any n-3 three-cycle packing against a global n-4 minimum, a return b->t from a packed cycle forces every t-target on that support to forward distance at most three from b.
In the F3 residual-three heavy state, any H->t return compresses the packing to an exact-R4 globally minimum packing, or yields four cycles if the exchanged remainder is cyclic.
A light return either gives the same exact-R4 compression or is the unique tight consecutive two-target pivot swapping t into the support and b+ into the remainder.
After excluding exact-R4 restart, H contributes no in-neighbor of t and each light support at most one; 3-vertex-strongness therefore forces at least one legal light pivot in every surviving state.
Iteration reduces the old static heavy-R3 leaf to a finite defect-one pivot orbit with outputs SIX, cyclic residual/four cycles, exact-R4 compression, or another pivot.
